title: RB Jonathon Brooks out of practice with soreness, but Panthers unconcerned

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: RB Jonathon Brooks out of practice with soreness, but Panthers unconcerned
sources.description: Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks remained out of practice on Wednesday, but head coach Dave Canales is unconcerned that Brooks' injury will keep him out of the season opener.
